title: The collector: real tables for the students every night, in shadow, capped, never a sealed table, never the server's workspace
request: The owner's step 4: 'The collector agent: every night it finds real tables, runs the students in shadow, and queues the disagreements for you'; a $20 budget.
spec: docs/guides/STUDENTS_100_PLAN.md S2: guards (a cap per run and per month, the 80% rule, the store's consent, never a sealed set), a run record per run.
plan: A job of kind collect queued by the worker's nightly sweep when DCLAB_COLLECTOR=1.
New OpenML candidates profiled into their own folder, so real_v1 never changes.
Train tables as homework, dev tables measured, sealed tables only profiled, for real_v2.
Claude's silver opinion on new disagreements within the caps; measured again; a run record.
Review by dclab-reviewer, every finding fixed with a test.

decisions.decision: Caps: EUR 0.5 a run, EUR 10 a month by default (DCLAB_COLLECTOR_RUN_EUR, DCLAB_COLLECTOR_MONTHLY_EUR).
decisions.why: The owner's rule for a live run (<= EUR 0.5) and the plan's suggested monthly cap that the owner pasted back; the first draft's 1.5 and 18 went past both.

decisions.decision: A copy of a known table is set aside, by its columns' names, whichever split it falls in.
decisions.why: OpenML re-uploads tables under new ids; the split is by id, so a copy could sit in the exam while its original is homework.

decisions.decision: real_v2 is built from the collector's tables only, once, then frozen.
decisions.why: real_v1's sealed partition is spent for roles; a fresh exam must hold no table any student trained on.

decisions.decision: OpenML only for now; benchgen v2 and self-play not wired.
decisions.why: Real tables are what the students lacked (invented-only students lost to the rules on real tables); the other sources are separate packages.

change: dclab_rnd/collector.py (new), dclab_rnd/real_shadow.py (exclusive lock, own_books, silver checkpoint, two derived folders), dclab_rnd/real_homework.py (build from given datasets), dclab_rnd/lake/openml.py (profile into another folder; fetch skips the collector's tables), dclab_rnd/jobs (sweep, handler, settle by reason), tests/run_parallel.py, export/manifest.py, dclab_rnd/archive.py, .gitignore, tests

findings.defect: Inside a job every decision went to the server's workspace.
findings.scenario: The worker binds context.using(env); ledger.current_ledger() returns env.ledger and ignores the installed book: dev tables stamped train in agent_runs, measured later on themselves.
findings.cause: install() sets only the process fallback; bound services win.
findings.fix: real_shadow.own_books(): context.using(None) around the loop, the fallback ledger and DCLAB_DECISION_SHADOW restored afterwards.

findings.defect: real_v2's sealed exam could hold copies of training tables.
findings.scenario: did 46757 depression_2020 (sealed) has the columns of lake train table 43419 depression; 45067 okcupid_stem (train) copies real_v1 sealed 41440.
findings.cause: Splits by dataset id; re-uploads get new ids.
findings.fix: twin_of: column-name Jaccard >= 0.8, or the same name without a year and >= 0.5: set aside as near-duplicate.

findings.defect: The month cap could be passed: two runs at once, or a run killed after Claude answered.
findings.scenario: 17.0 of 18 spent, two overlapping runs each get 1.0: 19.0; make dev restarts the worker after silver: the spend never written.
findings.cause: No lock; spend written only at the end.
findings.fix: real_shadow.exclusive (flock, non-blocking: Busy makes a skipped run; the CLI takes it too); the cap reserved in state.json before silver and settled after.

findings.defect: The open export would ship collector.py and real_shadow.py and fail its import check.
findings.scenario: INCLUDE dclab_rnd/**; CLOSED does not exclude files.
findings.test: tests/test_open_cli.py passes; grep: every other import goes through optional()

findings.defect: A test server's worker could start the real collector.
findings.scenario: DCLAB_COLLECTOR=1 in .env: a long test queues collect against the real folders and OpenML.
findings.cause: run_parallel's child_env did not default it.

findings.defect: One night offline used up the candidates for ever.
findings.scenario: Every exception wrote a skipped marker; failures skipped the sleep: 100 tables marked in seconds.
findings.cause: Network failures treated as unreadable tables.
findings.fix: A network failure (real_shadow.is_retry) leaves no mark; three in a row end the gathering; a derivation lost to the network is removed and derived again first.

findings.defect: A run skipped by a guard used up the night; a person's Stop restarted within the hour.
findings.scenario: The learning pilot running at sweep time every night: the collector never ran.
findings.cause: _keep set the done clock for skipped runs; settle called failed() for any reason.
findings.fix: A skipped run sets failed_clock (an hour); failed(reason='stopped') sets the clock (a night); a run starts only at night (DCLAB_COLLECTOR_HOURS, 0-7).

findings.defect: Stop did not reach Claude's step.
findings.scenario: After Stop, Claude kept being asked up to the run's cap.
findings.fix: silver(checkpoint=) before each request; the reserved cap stays counted when it stops.

findings.defect: The exam could freeze too small.
findings.scenario: Failed derivations counted; is_identifier has few tables that declare a row identifier.
findings.fix: exam_status counts per point, skips failed derivations, names the thin points.

findings.defect: real_v2's sealed rows were not ignored by git nor kept by the archive.
findings.scenario: A broad git add would commit sealed.jsonl.
findings.fix: .gitignore real_v2/* but its MANIFEST; archive SOURCES real_v2 and agent_runs/collector.

findings.defect: The lake could profile the collector's tables.
findings.scenario: openml.fetch(limit>1200) would put a table in both the lake and real_v2.
findings.cause: fetch did not look at the collector's folder.
findings.fix: fetch skips ids the collector holds.

findings.defect: real_homework.build built from nothing when given datasets.
findings.cause: The parameter 'records' was overwritten by a local list of the same name.

measurements.name: tests
measurements.gate: affected files only (the owner's daytime rule)
measurements.result: 102 tests in 8 files pass (collector 14, real_shadow 7, real_homework 8, jobs, lake, archive, decision_gate, open_cli)
limits: no live run yet: free disk was under the 3 GB guard

outcome: The collector is built, reviewed and fixed; it runs only when switched on (DCLAB_COLLECTOR=1), at night, with 3 GB free and the Mac under 80% busy. Not yet run live.
lessons: Inside a job the bound services decide where writes go: a module that installs its own ledger must also unbind the services, or its writes land in the server's workspace.
Splitting public tables by id is not enough: re-uploads under new ids put copies across the split; compare their columns.
risks: Done-when not yet met: two nightly runs growing the neediest points' homework (no live run yet).
Nothing picks the neediest points: OpenML tables feed every column point at once; benchgen and self-play are not wired.
Only a pgrep check coordinates with the learning agent; no shared queue or budget.
